conventions:
Figure of the l=1 non-Born proton Compton multipoles below the pion-production threshold, as dynamical
polarisabilities:  BChPT main fit ("NNLO fit": v2 code, alpha_E1, beta_M1 and their covariance read from
work/fits/results/fits_L.json['F2_d_all_thB'], spin polarisabilities at NNLO) with the band from the (alpha, beta)
fit covariance, the parameter-free NNLO prediction, the PWA fit of the paper ("PWA fit": main database = all data
minus the 3-sigma outlier TAPS 108.42/133 (update_fits.MAIN_DROP), legacy normalisations floated, configuration
main_fits.MAIN), and the published KLP18 Fit 1 and Fit 1'' (PLB 782 (2018) 34, Fig. 4, recovered from the vector
graphics).

Conventions (identical for all curves/points; = make_figures.DYN / HMP16 Eq. 3.46 / KLP18 notebook):
  non-Born c.m. multipoles fbar^{l+-}_{rho' rho}(omega) of compton.py (HMP16 Eqs. 3.19-3.22; Phi = T/(8 pi sqrt s)),
  omega = c.m. photon energy = E_lab/sqrt(1 + 2 E_lab/M), plotted against the LAB photon energy E_gamma;
  alpha_E1(w) = [2 f_EE^{1+} + f_EE^{1-}]/w^2,  beta_M1(w) = [2 f_MM^{1+} + f_MM^{1-}]/w^2,
  gamma_E1E1(w) = [f_EE^{1+} - f_EE^{1-}]/w^3,  gamma_M1M1(w) = [f_MM^{1+} - f_MM^{1-}]/w^3,
  gamma_E1M2(w) = 6 f_EM^{1+}/w^3,  gamma_M1E2(w) = 6 f_ME^{1+}/w^3.

bchpt.settings: work/code_v2 ampl.exe, dvertex=t, pimassphys=t, nmassphys=t, consts='LMP15'; baryon.dat M_N = 0.93827 GeV; multipoles from pwa_gaga (16-pt Gauss, J<=5/2) minus Born+pi0

pwa_main.config: main_fits.MAIN + floating normalisations of the legacy sets {'Oxley': 0.1, 'Pugh': 0.1, 'Hyman': 0.1, 'Bernardini': 0.1, 'Goldansky': 0.08}; main database = all points minus [('TAPS2001', 108.42, 133.0)]

klp18_published.source: KLP18 Fig. 4 (arXiv source polarizabilities_NEW_v2.pdf), vector-digitised; errors as published (global parameters only, residual functions fixed)

v1_projection_crosscheck.note: v2 pwa_gaga (v1 mode) vs compton.pw_project of v1-copy helicity amplitudes (20-pt endpoint-avoiding Gauss)

bchpt_residual_functions.note: KLP18 Eq. (3) residuals implied by the BChPT main-fit multipoles; 1e-4 fm^3 (fR1-4), 1e-4 fm^4 (fR5,6)
